app_store.name: Linegist
app_store.subtitle: The ten lines worth reading
app_store.promotional_text: Paste a log, get the lines that matter with a reason for each. Flat price per scan.
app_store.description:
Linegist reads a log sample and returns the ten lines worth your attention, ranked, each with the reason it was picked.

Paste a sample. Rules catch the known problems. Frequency analysis catches lines that look unlike the rest. You get a short list instead of ten thousand lines.

What you get:
- Ten ranked lines, each with a reason and line number
- Flat monthly price per scan, with a hard cap and no overage bill
- Nothing stored by default; secrets masked in results
- Your own rules and an API for CI

Free for 20 scans a month.
